title: Delphi Test-Authorization Request
description: The payload of an `authorization.request.staged` event (spec 092 TA-0): a request for the operator to authorize a few exact commands for a future headless test. Written only by the daemon, in a mission log. It is inert (tier L0), grants nothing, and is usable by no run. `taint` is computed by the daemon from the span (agent) or fixed at federated_peer (host); never taken from the request's text. The `request` text fields are the requester's words and data, stripped of control and escape characters and cut to fixed lengths.

argv.description: The canonical argument vector; argv[0] is the absolute canonical path of the binary. No shell string, glob, wrapper, chaining or inline code.

files.description: Absolute paths of every script or file the command reads and executes; hashed when the operator authorizes.

request_hash.description: blake3 of the whole request; stored in the record the operator makes from it.

label.description: `<role>/<family>/<model>` for an agent, `host:<tool>/<model>` for a host.

tier.description: An agent span at federated_peer (L1) or lower is refused at staging; L1 appears only on a host's request, which has no span.

run.description: The run the per-run limits count against: the task for an agent, the host session for a host.

mission.description: The mission log the request is staged in; the same payload is held in the workspace ledger, which is what the operator's commands check it against.
